items.description:
Roamwork at The Harrington in Zonnebloem is a flexible coworking space. The options include hot desks that can be booked when needed, flex bundles valid for three months, dedicated desks with a lockable drawer, and private offices for teams or individuals.

Meeting rooms are available for executive board meetings on flexible hourly bookings, and the site also offers event spaces. The company says its workspaces are designed for focus, privacy and productivity, with service that is prioritised and no hidden costs.

The space is on the second floor of The Harrington on Harrington Street in Zonnebloem, and it suits freelancers, remote workers and small teams who need a professional base in Cape Town's city centre.

Rosedene Guest House is a bed and breakfast on Upper Kloof Street in Higgovale, on the slopes of Table Mountain. The house began as a farmhouse dating back to the late 1800s and has been converted over the years into a guesthouse with a main house and a detached suite that overlooks the plunge pool.

The deluxe en-suite rooms are described as beautifully appointed, and breakfast is included, served daily in the breakfast room or the enclosed glass veranda. The veranda, terrace and courtyard have views of Table Mountain, Lions Head, Signal Hill, the city and Table Bay.

The guesthouse suits guests who want a quiet courtyard base close to the city centre, and reviews on Google mention the views and the breakfast buffet.

Rubyyes South Africa is a resortwear and beachwear label with a shop at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock. The business describes its collections as a blend of luxury resortwear and boho-chic beachwear, and says it is the sole importer of the Australian brand RYY, alongside labels such as Arnhem Clothing and Antica Sartoria.

The clothing features unique prints and embellishments in feminine, flowy styles with a bohemian touch. The range includes embellished tunics, tops and maxi dresses, cut from quality fabrics for easy wear from the beach to the bar.

The shop suits shoppers looking for holiday and sunshine wardrobes with a bohemian flair, and it is in the Albert Road area of Woodstock.

SA Autoparts is a motor spares business in Elsies River, Cape Town, which says it has been the go-to source for engines, gearboxes and other auto parts for more than 25 years. Its range includes new motor engines and half engines for makes such as Hyundai, Kia, Isuzu, Nissan, Ford, Lexus and Porsche.

The gearbox range covers manual, automatic and DSG units, and the engine parts range includes cylinder heads, camshafts, carburettors, crankshafts, crank pulleys and oil pumps. The website lists stock by category and shows its top-selling engines.

The business is at 43 Halt Road, Elsies River, and suits mechanics and car owners who need engines, gearboxes or parts sourced from one supplier.

Sopra is an intimate Italian restaurant above The Village Hub in Scarborough, near Cape Point. Its food is guided by the seasons and made fresh every day, with handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza and seasonal dishes served in a relaxed, refined setting.

The restaurant offers natural wines and views of the Scarborough Beach coastline, and it hosts private events and celebrations, including birthdays, intimate gatherings and corporate dinners. The team says it will work with each host to create something memorable.

It is on the corner of Watsonia and Main Road, and it suits anyone who wants a seaside Italian dinner or a private celebration on the Cape Peninsula.

items.description:
The Foodbarn Cafe and Tapas is a cafe by day and tapas bar by night in Noordhoek, with a deli shop attached. The cafe serves breakfast and lunch every day, including a bistronomy lunch menu, and tapas dinners from Tuesday to Saturday, and it says it caters for everyone, including four-legged guests.

The deli shop sells freshly baked croissants and breads, home-cooked frozen meals, pantry essentials and fresh coffee, and it is open seven days a week. The business also hosts wine table events about every six weeks, with a winemaker, ten wines and eight paired courses at a Friday lunch.

It suits a relaxed breakfast, a long lunch or a tapas evening in Noordhoek, and it takes gift card and reservation bookings through its website.

The Hussar Grill Steenberg in Tokai is a grill restaurant serving steaks, grills and burgers, and its menu is also offered for delivery. The steaks include rump, fillet, sirloin, ribeye and a 600-gram T-bone, alongside Parmesan chicken breasts, spare ribs and The Hussar Burger.

The starters include chicken livers, which the menu calls its house specialty, sauteed in sherry, garlic and cream or peri-peri. Other starters include cured Springbok loin carpaccio, Cajun-style calamari seared with chorizo, beef trinchado with crispy onion rings and Dutch bitterballen.

The Steenberg branch suits diners who want a classic meat-focused meal with a range of starters to share.

items.description:
U-turn Thrift Shop in Durbanville is a charity shop that sells new and second-hand clothing, bedding, homeware and jewellery. It is one of 15 retail stores run by the U-turn group, which works with people experiencing homelessness.

The group says its social enterprises offer work opportunities and skills development training, and that participants are prepared for the open labour market, with some going on to permanent roles within the organisation. The group has operated for more than 25 years and runs a skills-based programme designed by a team that includes social workers, occupational therapists and life coaches.

The shop is at 34 Wellington Road in Durbanville, and it suits shoppers who want to support a social enterprise while buying clothing and homeware.

Wilcote Cape Town is a roofing, waterproofing and painting business based in Killarney Gardens. Its services include roof installation and repairs, roof and balcony waterproofing, high-pressure roof cleaning and spray painting of walls and roofs, along with renovations and extensions, plastering, brickwork and tiling.

The company uses Torch-On waterproofing and also deals with roofing leaks, ceiling damp and property maintenance. It says it serves residential, commercial and industrial properties across Cape Town, including Blouberg, Claremont, the CBD and Durbanville.

The team offers expert advice, free inspections and a free, no-obligation quote, and it suits homeowners and businesses that need roof or building maintenance in Cape Town.

items.description:
African Oils sells extra virgin oils from South Africa, which it says it sources directly from farmers. Its speciality is extra virgin olive oil, and the range also includes naturally flavoured, infused and organic olive oils, along with the Botanical Collection, which includes Cape Wild Sage, Cape Buchu and Rose Geranium olive oils.

The Flame high heat cooking oil is a blend of olive pomace oil and extra virgin olive oil, sold in one-litre and five-litre sizes. Five-litre bottles of extra virgin olive oil, nut and seed oils and high heat cooking oils are offered for better value per litre, and gift packs are available.

The site also lists refined palm oil and pomace olive oil for soap making, and premium coconut flour. The business is based in Paarden Eiland, and it suits home cooks who want locally sourced oils in a range of sizes.

Alphen Veterinary Hospital is a small animal hospital in the heart of Constantia, treating cats and dogs. It offers a full wellness service, covering preventative healthcare and advanced healthcare, and it holds Cat Friendly accreditation.

The practice describes itself as a well-established small animal practice that puts emphasis on preventative medicine and wellness. It works closely with specialists when a case needs more advanced care, and it includes holistic regimens in some treatment plans where appropriate.

The hospital also has a shop and aims to keep the visit stress-free for pets, and it suits pet owners in Constantia and the surrounding area who want clear, compassionate veterinary advice.

Belting Edge is a Cape Town conveyor belt supplier and manufacturer based in Killarney Gardens. It supplies transmission belting, plastic modular belting, timing belting, belt fasteners and related tools, and it offers on-site hot and cold splicing, pulley lagging and general splicing solutions.

Its belting is sold to industries including corrugated board, can manufacturing and filling, bakery and milling, printing, pulp and converting, and ceramic tile production. The business says it is mainly based in the Western Cape, with clients across the country and a growing international client base.

It suits factories and production lines that need belting, fasteners or on-site splicing from a specialist supplier.

Blou Winkel in Kraaifontein is a general store that was established in 1973. The business describes itself as a unique store that specialises in motor spares and accessories, hardware, plumbing and electrical spares, and says it offers groceries, locksmith services and much more.

Other lines include LPG gas refill and delivery, automotive paints and cycle spares. The listing places the business under categories including automobile batteries, car parts and accessories, motorbikes, tractor parts and spares, and electrical services, so it covers a broad range of needs for motorists and households.

The store is at 254 Voortrekker Road in Kraaifontein, and it suits motorists, handymen and households in the area who need a range of parts and everyday supplies under one roof.

Chas Everitt Cape Town South is an estate agency at Westlake Shopping Centre, covering the Southern Suburbs, Constantiaberg and False Bay. Its services include buying, selling and letting property, and it offers a free market assessment that shows homeowners what their property could achieve.

The agency says its agents live and work in the suburbs they sell, from Newlands and Claremont to Constantia, Tokai, Kirstenhof and Muizenberg. It describes a proven track record and genuine local insight, and it aims to match each home with buyers who will appreciate its location and character.

The wider Chas Everitt International Property Group has built its reputation over more than four decades. The office suits sellers, buyers and tenants across an area from Observatory to Simon's Town.

COY is a seafood-led restaurant at the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town, with sweeping views of the city. It comes from the team behind Salsify at the Roundhouse in Camps Bay, and it focuses on sea-to-table cooking with southern African flavours.

The menu uses seasonal ingredients and traditional African cooking techniques, including fermenting, with plenty of freshly caught seafood and ethically sourced meat options. The dishes are described as a celebration of nature and heritage.

The restaurant is in Shop 151 at the Scherwyn Pavilion building, and it suits diners who want a considered seafood meal with views over the city.

The business says it offers quality-assured hire items, a professional and friendly team and reliable logistics, so that hosts can plan events with confidence. Showroom visits are by appointment only, and Google reviews rate the business 4.9 from nine reviews.

The business is at Unit 5A, Natal Street, Paarden Eiland, and its blog covers event planning topics such as florists, caterers and conference venues in Cape Town.

Electrician CPT is an electrical contractor serving Lotus River and nearby suburbs such as Grassy Park and Retreat. Its residential services include emergency electrical work, light fittings, switches and plug repairs, tripping power and faulty DB boards, and UPS installations.

It also installs electric fences and residential solar systems, carries out commercial three-phase installations and upgrades, and handles warehouse and industrial electrical work. Electrical Certificates of Compliance are issued for property sales, rentals and renovations across the Southern Suburbs.

The business says it has more than 10 years of experience, has completed over 800 projects and is fully insured, and that it is registered with the Electrical Contractors' Association of South Africa. Emergency call-outs in Lotus River are typically on site within the hour, seven days a week.

items.description:
Hartlief Gourmet in the Gardens Shopping Centre is a European-style deli that opened to the South African public on 1 November 2016. It has since been revamped and enlarged, with a new layout designed to improve customer flow.

The deli now has more seating inside and extra seating outside in the mall, a coffee bar serving coffee and sandwiches, and an extended hot food section. The aim was to keep a European feel while adding modern elements and showcasing the products on offer.

The deli promotes pure Namibian lamb and has cold meat and gourmet products. It suits Gardens shoppers who want a sit-down meal, a coffee or take-home meat and deli products.
